description: A deliberate deadlock: t.a reads ch.ba before it sends on ch.ab, and t.b reads ch.ab before it sends on ch.ba, so each waits on a value only the other can send. Both stay parked on a recv while holding the sender that would wake the other, nothing is ever sent, and the run ends with both tasks Running: the stuck-task identity Rust's snapshot leaves and C's report names must be the same two tasks.
